spec.situation_desc: had a loan application declined with no explanation

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Thistle Bank, Marcus speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Femi Thornbury. My loan application’s been declined and nobody’s explained why. I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry you’ve been left without an explanation, Femi. I can see there was a £12.50 returned-payment fee on your current account on 14 October, as well. Is that the sort of thing you’re calling about?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: No, I’m calling about the loan. I don’t know why you’re bringing up my account details.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re right to question that, and I’m sorry. I should have checked your identity before discussing any account details. Let me do that now. Could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address and your postcode?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. I understand you want an explanation for the loan decision and you’re unhappy that none was given. I’m logging this as a complaint.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Someone will be in touch about it, and the complaints team will review what happened. I can’t promise what the outcome will be.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Can you tell me when someone will contact me?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can’t give you a timescale for that at the moment. I will take ownership of following this up: I’ll send the complaint to our complaints team today, and I’ll call you by 4 pm tomorrow to confirm it’s been passed on.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Just to make sure I’ve explained it clearly: I’ve logged your complaint about the declined loan and the lack of an explanation. I’ll send it to the complaints team today and call you by 4 pm tomorrow to confirm that’s happened. The team will be in touch after that, but I can’t say when or what the outcome will be. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, that makes sense. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Femi. I’m sorry again for the way this has been handled, and I’ll call you by 4 pm tomorrow.
